dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: A nearby tee time was found and confirmed in one call
highlights.summary: A two-player caller asked to play at 4:45 PM that day. SpeakSport presented the closest available times, completed the 4:50 PM booking and answered the follow-up question about cart availability.
highlights.quote: “The closest available tee times I have for 2 players today are 4:30, 4:40, 4:50, and 5:00 PM.” The caller selected 4:50 PM, and SpeakSport confirmed the reservation.

highlights.title: A four-player request was converted from a preferred time
highlights.summary: When a four-player group asked for 10:00 AM the next day, SpeakSport provided the closest choices, secured 10:10 AM and completed the confirmation during the call.
highlights.quote: “We have tee times available for 4 players tomorrow at 10:10 AM, 10:40 AM, 10:50 AM, and 11:00 AM.” The 10:10 AM tee time was then confirmed.

highlights.title: Practice-facility information was handled immediately
highlights.summary: A caller looking to use the range received a clear explanation of the daily-access option, what it includes and the cashless-payment policy—without needing staff assistance.
highlights.quote: “The daily access fee is $35, which includes unlimited use of the driving range, chipping areas, and the putting green.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love San Juan Oaks to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
